newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey expects 10 mln tourists in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Turkey expects 10 mln tourists in 1997.

text.p: Turkish Tourism Minister Bahattin Yucel said on Monday more than ten million tourists were expected to visit Turkey in 1997 after an 11 percent rise to around eight million in 1996, the Anatolian agency reported.

"Turkey has seen a growth in the number of tourists in 1996 above the world average. Eight million tourists visited Turkey in 1996, a rise of 11 percent compared to last year. We are expecting more than ten million tourists in 1997," Yucel said during an inspection of Ataturk airport in Istanbul.
Yucel said the increase in the number of visitors necessitated a constant improvements in Turkey's airport facilities. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
